prompt: My wife left me,  I have never been single since I was living with my parents.   What do I do now?  Where can I turn too? (I am not mentally ill in any way)
response: It's tough to go from being part of a couple to being single again. You might want to consider seeing a therapist to help you work through your feelings. In the meantime, focus on taking care of yourself and maybe give yourself some time to adjust. It's okay to reach out to friends for support too.
